tie_rules.0: point values, rival >= rnel_stream (beats: rival > rnel_stream)
tie_rules.A: rival ties or beats if rnel_stream - rival < 0.005; beats if <= -0.005
tie_rules.B: paired bootstrap over runs (seed x fold), 2000 draws: ties/beats if 95% CI of rnel_stream - rival includes 0 or is < 0; beats if CI < 0
tie_rules.C: marginal CIs from summary.json overlap (or rival point higher)
